title: Local or Escalate? Post-Training Expert Routing for Real-Time Duplex Speech Models
summary: A probe trained on typed questions detected speech-answer failures in unseen human recordings, an experimentally measured cross-modal result.
ai_technology: Logistic probe on language-model hidden states for speech-answer failure detection
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Primary results report discrimination on unseen human speech recordings, beyond the system-level routing result.
evidence.unknown: Evaluation was on selected internal/external speech-QA datasets; it does not establish general calibration.
evidence.ai_role: A logistic readout on typed-question hidden states was applied to speech-question states without refitting.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
